detail.title: State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away
detail.description: Nous Research retrained Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B to produce Arete-27B, largely stripping out its pro-Chinese bias. The political bias is "applied late, it is applied thin," the team writes.
